skill.name: aeon
skill.description: Guides time series machine learning with Aeon across classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, similarity search, transformations, distances, and benchmarking.
skill.summary: Select and apply Aeon workflows for time series modeling and evaluation.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 99 static findings are false positives caused by ordinary Python imports, machine-learning terms, Markdown formatting, a fixed GPU selector, and documentation links. No prompt injection, secret access, data exfiltration, dynamic code loading, or untrusted command execution was found.

static_findings.snippet: Use grid search or random search:
1. **Fit on training data only**: Avoid data leakage
Categorize time series into predefined classes. See `references/classification.md` for complete algo
Predict continuous values from time series. See `references/regression.md` for algorithms.
Group similar time series without labels. See `references/clustering.md` for methods.
Predict future time series values. See `references/forecasting.md` for forecasters.
Identify unusual patterns or outliers. See `references/anomaly_detection.md` for detectors.
Partition time series into regions with change points. See `references/segmentation.md`.
Find similar patterns within or across time series. See `references/similarity_search.md`.
Transform time series for feature engineering. See `references/transformations.md`.
Specialized temporal distance measures. See `references/distances.md` for complete catalog.
Neural architectures for time series. See `references/networks.md`.
Load standard benchmarks and evaluate performance. See `references/datasets_benchmarking.md`.
3. **Check Data Format**: Aeon expects shape `(n_samples, n_channels, n_timepoints)`

content.value_statement: General machine-learning methods often miss temporal structure and specialized evaluation needs. This skill guides Aeon model selection, preprocessing, training, and benchmarking for time series tasks.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Aeon estimators for classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search.
Explains temporal preprocessing, normalization, missing-value handling, feature extraction, and scikit-learn compatible pipelines.
Shows how to use specialized distances, including DTW and related elastic measures.
Guides benchmark dataset loading and task-specific performance evaluation.
Covers deep learning architectures and GPU selection for larger time series workloads.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples but does not bundle Aeon, datasets, or trained models.
Requires users to supply data and verify its shape, labels, sampling, and quality.
Algorithm availability and import paths can differ across installed Aeon versions.
Deep learning workflows may require optional dependencies, substantial compute, and careful tuning.

use_cases.title: Classify Sensor Signals
use_cases.description: Choose a fast baseline, normalize multichannel signals, train an Aeon classifier, and evaluate held-out accuracy.
use_cases.target_user: Data scientists working with labeled sensor data

use_cases.title: Forecast Operational Demand
use_cases.description: Compare forecasting approaches, define a horizon, validate chronologically, and report errors for planning.

use_cases.title: Benchmark Temporal Models
use_cases.description: Load standard datasets, compare estimators with task-specific metrics, and apply statistical tests across results.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starting Model
prompt_templates.prompt: I have [task], [sample count], [channels], and [timepoints]. Recommend one Aeon baseline and explain required preprocessing and evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Validation Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Aeon workflow for [task]. Include data shape checks, leakage prevention, train-validation splitting, metrics, and a simple baseline.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Algorithms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [algorithm A], [algorithm B], and [algorithm C] for my [dataset description]. Assess accuracy, speed, interpretability, memory, and tuning needs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reproducible Benchmark
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Aeon benchmarking plan for [research question]. Include datasets, estimators, task-specific metrics, cross-validation, statistical tests, resource controls, and reporting criteria.

output_examples.input: Find a fast classifier for 2,000 multichannel sensor samples with 500 timepoints.
output_examples.output: Start with MiniRocketClassifier after checking Aeon collection shape and applying training-fitted normalization. Compare accuracy and runtime against a one-nearest-neighbor Euclidean baseline.

output_examples.input: Plan anomaly detection evaluation for labeled event windows in one long signal.
output_examples.output: Use a window-based detector and reserve labeled events for threshold selection. Report range precision, range recall, range F-score, and ROC AUC.

output_examples.input: Compare forecasting methods for monthly demand with a six-month horizon.
output_examples.output: Use chronological validation and define the forecast horizon before fitting. Compare ARIMA with a naive baseline using absolute and squared error metrics.

best_practices: Fit preprocessing only on training data, then reuse the fitted transformations on validation and test data.
Start with a fast baseline before adding ensembles or deep learning models.
Report data shape, split strategy, random seeds, metrics, runtime, and hardware.
anti_patterns: Do not use random splits when they leak future observations into training.
Do not select complex models without comparing a simple temporal baseline.
Do not treat anomaly thresholds or forecast horizons as universal across datasets.

faq.question: Does this skill install Aeon?
faq.answer: No. It provides installation guidance and usage examples, but package installation remains an explicit environment operation.

faq.question: Which time series tasks are covered?
faq.answer: It covers classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, similarity search, transformations, distances, networks, datasets, and benchmarking.

faq.question: Can it handle multivariate time series?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance covers univariate and multivariate collections when the selected Aeon estimator supports the provided data shape.

faq.question: Does Aeon work with scikit-learn workflows?
faq.answer: Many Aeon estimators use familiar fit, predict, transform, and score interfaces and can participate in compatible pipelines.

faq.question: Is a GPU required?
faq.answer: No. Many classical and convolution-based methods run on CPUs, while deep learning models can benefit from GPU acceleration.

faq.question: Does the skill send my data anywhere?
faq.answer: The skill contains guidance only and defines no data-upload behavior. Review any separate tools or services used in your workflow.
